blocks.html: Supports for cooling towers, evaporative condensers and fluid coolers shall be designed in accordance with the New York City Building Code. Seismic restraints shall be as required by the New York City Building Code. Adequate vibration isolation shall be provided in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines and as required for the supporting structure, and in accordance with Sections 313.3.7 and 313.3.8.
